blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-order dependencies among views can be modeled by tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) in multi-view subspace clustering. However, the tensor nuclear norm often used with this framework assigns the same asymptotic marginal penalty to singular values of different magnitudes, which may excessively shrink dominant components that encode cluster structure. We propose HTNN-MSC, which replaces this norm with a bounded hyperbolic tangent tensor rank surrogate. The surrogate is strictly concave on the positive half-axis and has a Lipschitz continuous derivative. Its marginal penalty decreases as singular values grow. We develop an alternating direction method of multipliers solver in which the tensor subproblem decomposes into scalar frequency-domain shrinkage problems. Safeguarded multi-start Newton iterations and candidate-objective comparison implement the resulting hyperbolic tangent thresholding operator. The shape parameter is scaled by the input spectrum. We also establish o-minimal definability of the augmented objective. Under explicit boundedness, descent, relative-error, and exact-block conditions, the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz framework guarantees convergence of the full sequence to a KKT point. On 23 datasets, HTNN-MSC achieves a mean clustering accuracy of 0.8404 and an average accuracy rank of 2.78 against nine representative methods. Friedman tests and Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon comparisons reveal significant overall differences, although several pairwise differences remain nonsignificant. HTNN-MSC records 19 wins, one tie, and three losses against the convex t-SVD-MSC skeleton. A same-skeleton ablation also shows that the proposed surrogate does not uniformly outperform alternative nonconvex penalties.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multiple sensors, modalities, or feature extractors can provide complementary descriptions of a common set of objects. For example, intensity, texture, and shape features offer distinct characterizations of an image, whereas multilingual versions of a news article provide different textual views. By exploiting information shared across these representations together with view-specific cues, multi-view clustering seeks to partition data without labels Liu et al. [2026] . Multi-view subspace clustering (MVSC) addresses data whose samples approximately occupy a collection of low-dimensional subspaces. It learns within-view coefficients that express each sample through other samples, and then converts these coefficients into an affinity graph.
blocks.zh: 多个传感器,模式,或特征提取器可以对一组共同的物体提供补充描述. 例如,强度、纹理和形状特征为图像提供了不同的特征,而新闻文章的多语种版本提供了不同的文字观点。 多视图群集通过利用在这些表述中共享的信息以及针对特定视图的提示,试图在没有标签的情况下分割数据Liu等人. [2026] (中文(简体) ). 多视图子空间群集(MVSC)处理其样本大约占据了一组低维子空间的数据. 它学习通过其他样本表达每个样本的内视系数,然后将这些系数转换成亲和图.

blocks.en: To obtain these coefficients, sparse subspace clustering uses a sparsity prior, whereas low-rank representation adopts a low-rank prior Elhamifar and Vidal [2013] , Liu et al. [2013] . Learning each view independently, however, can miss dependencies between views. Tensor-based MVSC instead stacks the view-specific representations into a third-order tensor and constrains their joint structure. The choice of tensor rank surrogate then determines how the model suppresses noise and retains principal cluster structure.

blocks.en: Many t-SVD-based models use the tensor nuclear norm (TNN) Lu et al. [2020] . Its convexity simplifies optimization, but its derivative with respect to each positive singular value is constant. Small coefficients associated with noise and large coefficients associated with dominant structure therefore receive the same asymptotic marginal penalty. Nonconvex surrogates reduce this penalty as the singular value increases. Logarithmic Schatten- p p and generalized nonconvex tensor penalties illustrate this idea in MVSC Guo et al. [2023] , Chen et al. [2021] . Arctangent and refined-sigmoid penalties add bounded alternatives Sun et al. [2023] , Gu et al. [2024] . The remaining question is how a particular penalty affects shrinkage, numerical solution, parameter scaling, and convergence analysis.

blocks.en: We study ϕ θ ​ ( σ ) = tanh ⁡ ( σ / θ ) \phi_{\theta}(\sigma)=\tanh(\sigma/\theta) as a tensor rank surrogate. This function is bounded and smooth, strictly concave for σ > 0 \sigma>0 , and finite in derivative at the origin. It shrinks small coefficients while its marginal penalty vanishes for sufficiently large ones. We incorporate this penalty into a self-expression MVSC model and derive an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver. The resulting mapping, called hyperbolic tangent thresholding (HTT), is evaluated from three starting points with safeguarded Newton updates and objective-value comparison.

blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions. 1. We formulate the hyperbolic tangent tensor surrogate and establish its boundedness, strict concavity, Lipschitz derivative, rank-approximation limit, and definability in an o-minimal structure. 2. We derive a two-penalty ADMM algorithm that matches the implementation. A data-adaptive rule sets θ \theta from the initial frequency-domain spectrum, while the error-weight parameter remains dataset dependent. 3. We state the exact-block, descent, and relative-error conditions required for KL-based whole-sequence convergence. The statement distinguishes the theoretical algorithm from the practical multi-start HTT solver and does not treat tanh as semi-algebraic. 4. We compare ten methods on 23 datasets. HTNN-MSC achieves a mean ACC of 0.8404 and a mean NMI of 0.8029, with respective average ranks of 2.78 and 3.02. Friedman and Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon tests assess cross-dataset differences. Same-skeleton comparisons measure the change from convex soft thresholding and expose cases where other nonconvex surrogates perform better. Repeated post-processing, sensitivity analyses, convergence plots, and runtime measurements describe the numerical behavior of the method.

blocks.en: Rank is measured by the number of nonzero singular values; by contrast, the sum of their magnitudes defines the nuclear norm. MCP and SCAD reduce estimation bias by making the penalty derivative depend on coefficient size Zhang [2010] , Fan and Li [2001] . Logarithmic and Schatten- p p penalties also reduce pressure on large coefficients, but their derivatives can be unbounded or singular near the origin.

blocks.en: TLSpNM uses a logarithmic Schatten- p p penalty, and GNLTA considers a broader family of nonconvex tensor approximations. Arctangent and refined-sigmoid surrogates supply bounded alternatives. HTNN-MSC instead uses tanh, scales it from the input spectrum, and compares it with convex and nonconvex penalties in the same optimization skeleton. Its o-minimal formulation states the conditions needed for a KL convergence argument. The experiments evaluate these properties without assuming that they imply higher accuracy on every dataset.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: HTNN-MSC achieves the best mean ACC and NMI, the best average ranks, and significant Friedman test results across the benchmark. It also records 19 wins, one tie, and three losses against the convex skeleton. These aggregates coexist with weaker results on individual datasets, nonsignificant Holm-adjusted pairwise comparisons, and better average ACC from other penalties in the surrogate ablation. The evidence supports the tested shrinkage strategy without implying dominance in every setting.
blocks.zh: HTNN-MSC实现最佳平均ACC和NMI,最佳平均排名,以及跨越基准的重大弗里德曼测试结果. 也记录了19胜,1平,3败于对流骨架. 这些合计数与个别数据集结果较弱、无重大霍尔姆调整的对等比较、以及替代物减价中其他惩罚的更平均ACC并存。 证据支持经过测试的收缩策略,但不暗示在每一个场合中都占支配地位.

blocks.en: Five limitations delimit the current method. The best λ \lambda varies by several orders of magnitude, and adaptive θ \theta does not address error-weight selection. A label-free stability criterion could reduce this dependence. Results on 3Sources, MSRCv1, and Caltech101-7 also show that the tensor prior can be less effective than competing graph or tensor models. Heterogeneous view statistics, the sample-mode Fourier prior, and unsuitable λ \lambda are possible factors, but the experiments do not isolate their effects. Oracle selection of λ \lambda adds optimistic bias to the main benchmark. Repeated post-processing measures randomness only after selection, and the statistical tests do not correct this bias. Full-grid results, repeated complete pipelines, and label-free model selection would give a less optimistic evaluation. The O ⁡ ( V ​ n 3 ) O(Vn^{3}) direct solves and O ⁡ ( V ​ n 2 ) O(Vn^{2}) storage further restrict scalability. Anchor graphs, iterative linear solves, low-rank sketches, and graph-spectral transforms address different parts of this cost. The convergence theorem also assumes exact global block solutions and standard KL descent conditions. A certified bracketed HTT solver and a proof tailored to the implemented penalty schedule would connect the theorem more closely to practice.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: The proposed HTNN-MSC incorporates a bounded hyperbolic tangent surrogate for tensor rank into MVSC. By allowing the marginal penalty to diminish with singular-value magnitude while remaining finite at the origin, the surrogate alleviates excessive asymptotic shrinkage of dominant components. Its two-penalty ADMM solver uses frequency-domain HTT and a data-adaptive surrogate scale. Under exact-block and descent assumptions, the o-minimal formulation yields a KL-based whole-sequence convergence result.
blocks.zh: 拟议的HTNN-MSC在MVSC中加入了一个受限双曲正切代位数,用于拉伸级. 通过允许边际惩罚随着单值的减少而同时在原处保持有限,代位法缓解了主导成分的过度不对称收缩. 其双惩罚ADMM解析器使用频率域HTT和数据适应代位尺度. 在精确块和下位数假设下,o-最小配体产生基于KL的全序趋同结果.

blocks.en: Across 23 datasets and nine baselines, HTNN-MSC achieves the best mean ACC and average ACC rank. A controlled comparison shows an aggregate gain over the convex t-SVD-MSC skeleton. The surrogate ablation also identifies cases where logarithmic, Schatten- p p , or MCP penalties perform better. Repeatability and sensitivity experiments quantify spectral post-processing variation and the dependence on dataset-specific regularization. Certified scalar thresholding, label-free parameter selection, and scalable representations remain open tasks.
blocks.zh: 在23个数据集和9个基线中,HTNN-MSC实现了最佳平均行政协调会和平均行政协调会排名。 对照比较显示对流 t-SVD-MSC骨架上的总增益. 代孕者还确定了对数、Schatten-p、或MCP处罚表现较好的情况。 重复性和敏感性实验量化光谱处理后的变异性以及对数据集特定规范化的依赖. 认证的标定阈值,无标签参数选择,以及可缩放的表示仍然是未完成的任务.
